title: Candidate dedup (round 43) on exact parallel peak selection (round 42), measured together
semantics: MEASUREMENT round. No algorithm, kernel or default changes: every arm is an existing option on main 847e785. candidate_dedup_top_k=3 stays semantics-changing (outputs are not expected to equal dedup off) and off by default; peak mode 2 is exact (outputs equal peak mode 1 by round 42). GUI, core and research defaults are unchanged whatever the result.
implementation_note: 5c569f1 adds only tools/benchmark_dedup_peak2.py and tests/test_dedup_peak2_harness.py to main 847e785; C++, Metal and CMake sources are identical. The frozen runner is build/stage44-release (Release, GUI+experiments+OpenCV) built from this worktree at 5c569f1; its hash is recorded in every manifest.
question: Q1 (gated): on the full-GPU path with peak mode 2 (batch 8) and fine mode 4, does k3 still cut static time by at least 10% on many128_pose and many512_pose? Round 43's 26.1%/25.7% were measured with peak mode 1, where coarse peaks took about 1030 ms of the 512 profile; peak mode 2 removed most of that, so the fraction saved by dedup can differ.

Q2 (reported, names a winner only under the consistency rule): per new frame (every call through Session::updateSource), which of hybrid off, hybrid k3, full-GPU off and full-GPU k3 is fastest on each of the four formal cases?
baseline: Same build, same job, candidate_dedup_top_k=0 on the same method. Cross-method comparisons only per new frame (the hybrid reuses its pose context on static calls). Speedups are never multiplied with earlier rounds.

methods.hybrid_best: round-40 hybrid_best job (Metal coarse with exact CPU normalization, Metal fine and pose refinement)
methods.full_gpu_parallel: round-42 full_gpu_parallel: full_gpu=true, coarse_peak_mode 1, full_gpu_peak_mode 2, full_gpu_peak_batch 8, full_gpu_fine_mode 4

modes.static: round-40 job: cold first call (excluded), >= 1 s warm-up, measured calls on one source; clock = runner total_ms
modes.frames: round-41 sequence job: every call goes through Session::updateSource; warm-up calls then measured calls; clock = frame_wall_ms (updateSource plus run, excluding decode, comparison and JSON)

cases.formal: many128_pose, many512_pose, controlled6, 8k_t256_angle180_3scales (stage-37 fixtures, hashes checked)
cases.gt: the 79 round-43 GT case variants that have a full-GPU path (round-40 formal/holdout/stop0, round-34 challenge and Blender, round-33, round-34 scale support without the CPU-only support switch, round-35 49-object RGB, round-43 symmetric and adjacent controls regenerated by tools/candidate_dedup_scenes.py)

frame_warmup_calls.rule: three times the round-41 counts for every case and arm. Round 41 planned its counts for about 1 s at round-40 speed; the implementation smoke ran many128 full-GPU k3 frames at 387 ms, where two warm-up calls are below 1 s. Every worker must still show >= 1 s of warm-up wall time (gate).

phases.gt: 79 case variants x full_gpu_parallel x {off, k3}: one fresh process each, first call + 1 repeat, up to 2 in parallel; GT, residency, peak route and archive identity only, no timing claims
phases.pilot: 1 block x 8 arms x 4 cases, 2 measured calls; screening only, never decision evidence
phases.formal: 6 blocks x 8 arms x 4 cases, 3 measured calls, fresh process per case/arm/block, arm order reversed on odd blocks; refuses to start with competing build/benchmark processes
phases.profile: full_gpu_parallel static off/k3 on many128_pose and many512_pose with encoder timestamps, 2 measured calls; diagnostic only, never compared with formal timings

accuracy.strict: many_object_accuracy.evaluate: one-to-one, position <= 2 px, wrapped angle <= 1 degree, scale ratio within 2%; FP and FN both counted; no symmetry aliasing
accuracy.formal_gt: every first, warm-up (frames) and measured call has zero strict FP and FN (all four formal cases pass at baseline)
accuracy.gt_neutral_rule: k3 on peak mode 2 is GT-neutral when no GT case variant has fewer strict TP or more strict FP than peak-2 off (first call); known failures and controls included; a failed worker makes the phase not neutral

identity.round43_archive: every call's ordered matches and proposals (all fields) equal the round-43 archived first call of the same case, path and dedup arm (formal: raw-results-timing.tar.gz block 0; gt: raw-results-gt.tar.gz, plus candidate_dedup counters without times). Peak mode 2 equals peak mode 1 exactly (round 42) and the core, hybrid and dedup code are unchanged since round 43 except the exact UDOT dot product, so any difference is a failure
identity.jobs: static and GT jobs equal the round-43 jobs apart from full_gpu_peak_mode, full_gpu_peak_batch and repeats
identity.frames: every frames call's outputs equal the same arm's static first call
identity.note: identity with the dedup-off baseline is NOT expected for k3 and is reported in the GT phase only

gates.speed_target: full_gpu_parallel static k3 pooled median total_ms at least 10% below off, with all 6 paired block medians in the same direction, on many128_pose and many512_pose
gates.time_budget: controlled6 and 8k, static, both methods: each block k3 <= off + max(2 ms, 10%)
gates.rss: each mode and method: peak RSS k3 <= off + max(8 MiB, 10%)
gates.routes: residency (full GPU: 1 command buffer, 1 CPU wait, 0 intermediate readbacks, 0 CPU algorithm steps), requested fine mode executed, peak mode 2 with 1..8 maps per dispatch on every full-GPU call, dedup counters consistent with the arm on every call and constant across calls
gates.warmup: frames warm-up wall >= 1 s in every worker
gates.host: no competing build/benchmark process before any formal worker (recorded failure)

frames_ranking: per case, arms ordered by pooled median frame_wall_ms; the first is named fastest only when it is faster than each of the other three in every one of the 6 paired blocks and in the pooled medians; otherwise no fastest arm is named

decision.q1: full-GPU peak2+k3 is called suitable for many identical objects (outputs not identical to the baseline accepted) only if the GT phase is GT-neutral, every identity check passes and the speed target is met on both primary cases; time-budget and RSS failures are kept and reported
decision.q2: CURRENT_BEST names a per-new-frame configuration for a case only when the frames ranking names a fastest arm; otherwise the medians are reported without a winner
decision.defaults: no default changes in any outcome

memory: Process peak RSS, named Metal allocations (full_gpu.gpu_bytes; dedup-flags and dedup-counts exist only with k3) and hybrid frame/pose buffers are reported separately and never added.
pre_registration_disclosure: Before this protocol, the 847e785 integration replay (not this build directory) ran the 1146 round-43 GT jobs and the 474 full-GPU ones under peak mode 2: all outputs equal to the round-43 archive. That replay had no timing.

Implementation smoke on this frozen runner, many128_pose frames, 2 warm-up + 1 measured call per arm (seen, not evidence): hybrid off 855.9 ms, hybrid k3 609.6 ms, full-GPU off 588.8 ms, full-GPU k3 387.3 ms per frame; GT pass and routes valid on all four; dedup kept 20188/42458 (hybrid) and 22863/42460 (full GPU). The full-GPU k3 arm tripped the 1 s warm-up gate with round-41 counts, which led to the frame_warmup_calls rule above; nothing else was changed after the smoke.
k3, radius 0.5, angle_steps 3, peak batch 8, fine mode 4, the cases, blocks and gates were fixed before any run.
limits: Single Apple M4 Pro (48 GiB) Metal device
Synthetic or semi-synthetic ground truth; formal cases are the round-40 speed workloads (8K is a constant-background, upright, scale-1 speed workload)
GT has no symmetry equivalence; templates with a symmetry period below 3 coarse angle steps are not covered (round-43 limit)
Per-frame scope repeats the same source pixels through updateSource; changing-content sequences and real camera streams are not run
Sibling sessions may use the machine; host state is recorded for every worker
